description: highly detailed crisp pixel art scene, fine pixel detail: a small mysterious figure in a dark navy hooded cloak, its face a glowing ice-blue light, glowing ice-blue hands, seen from the side facing right, sitting at the end of a small wooden pier and holding a fishing rod over a misty forest pond at dawn, the line going down to a red and white float on the still water, lily pads and reeds, a wicker basket with a fish tail beside the figure, willow branches hanging above, the whole figure and the pier inside the frame

references.usage: the same small hooded figure: its dark navy cloak, its glowing ice-blue face and hands, its size in the frame and the fine pixel style; only the work and the place are new
